info.name: DMS API End-to-End Tests
info.description:
End-to-end API scenario for the Debate Management System: authentication, role-based access control, full tournament lifecycle (create → match → judge scoring → results), social features, and security checks.

Run against a disposable database. Requests run in order and share state through environment variables.

item.name: 01 Health & public pages
item.description: Endpoints a logged-out visitor uses on the home page.

item.name: Live matches (used by public home page)

request.description: The home page calls this without a token to show the "Live Matches" counter.

exec: pm.test("Visitors can load live matches (200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Invalid e-mail is rejected at signup
03 Role-based access control
item.description: Organizer-only actions attempted by other roles and by anonymous callers.

item.name: Debater tries to create a tournament

exec: pm.test("Blocked by the role check", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("Access Denied"));

item.name: Judge tries to create a match
Anonymous tries to create a tournament

exec: // Builds a correctly signed but already-expired token using the local JWT secret
const body = b64({ sub: "pm_debaterA_" + pm.environment.get("runId"), role: "DEBATER", iat: now - 7200, exp: now - 3600 });
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: "Authorization", value: "Bearer " + head + "." + body + "." + sig });
pm.test("Uses HTTP 401 so the frontend logs the user out", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: 04 Tournament lifecycle
item.description: Organizer builds a tournament; judges score; results propagate to stats and leaderboard.

item.name: Organizer creates tournament with schools, judges and template
Adding the same judge twice is rejected
Score template can be read back (judge score sheet)
Organizer creates a match with two judges

exec: pm.test("Has 'New Judging Assignment'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(n => n.title)).to.include("New Judging Assignment"));

item.name: Debater sees the match on the tournament page
Judge 2 cannot submit on behalf of judge 1
Match stays open until all judges submit
Judge 1 can see their submitted sheet
Match is completed with winner and best speaker

exec: pm.test("Trinity wins on average score", () => pm.expect(m.winnerSchool.name).to.eql("Trinity College"));
pm.test("Best speaker chosen by judges' votes", () => pm.expect(m.bestSpeaker.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get("debaterBId")));
pm.test("Trinity first with 2 points", () => { pm.expect(b[0].schoolName).to.eql("Trinity College"); pm.expect(b[0].points).to.eql(2); });

item.name: Next round needs at least two winners
05 Social features
item.description: Connections, messages, diaries, calendar, news, notifications, search, newsletter.

item.name: Debater A sends connection request to B
A cannot accept their own request
A sends a message to B

exec: pm.test("Message delivered", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(m => m.text)).to.include("Well played today!"));

item.name: B comments on the diary post
Debater cannot verify a diary post (organizer-only)
06 Ownership & privacy
item.description: Logged-in users must not change or see data that belongs to someone else.

item.name: Debater A edits debater B's profile

exec: pm.test("Cannot edit another user's profile (403)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: Debater B posts a discussion comment as debater A

exec: pm.test("Cannot post as another user (403)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: Judge 2 deletes a comment they don't own

exec: pm.test("Cannot delete another user's comment (403)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: Debater marks judge's notification as read

exec: pm.test("Cannot modify another user's notification (403)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: Anonymous user list hides e-mail addresses

exec: pm.test("No e-mail addresses exposed to visitors", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(u => u.email)).to.eql(false));
